div.div: 4 اطرّبهُ He, (S,) or it, (one's voice, A,) caused him to be affected with طَرَب [i. e. emotion, or a lively emotion, &c.]; as also ↓ تطرّبهُ ; (S, A;) [and ↓ طرّبهُ ; for] تَطْرِيبٌ signifies the same as إِطْرَابٌ, like ↓ تَطَرُّبٌ ; (K:) [generally, he, or it, rendered him lively, brisk, or sprightly: and] اطربهُ is said of joy, and of grief, meaning [it affected him with طَرَب; or] it rendered him restless, or unsteady. (MA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
